strings.support_methods_subtitle: E koho i kāu ala hāʻawi makemake. Hāʻawi kālā kēlā me kēia haʻawina i nā hoʻoiho, hoʻokipa, a me nā lako hoʻāʻo.

strings.support_story_1_body: Hoʻopuka pinepine ʻo Innioasis i nā firmwares hou no nā mea pāʻani e like me ka Y1 (e huli ana i nā loiloi papa huna e like me 6.0, 7.0, a me 8.0) e uhaʻi mālie i nā mea kahiko. ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi, hāʻawi kā lākou pūnaewele i nā ʻōlelo aʻo ʻole a me ka loaʻa ʻole i nā firmwares hana mua e hoʻihoʻi mai kahi moku bricked. ʻO ka Updater a me ka papahana Community Firmware e ʻohi i nā ʻāpana: hoʻopaʻa mākou i kēlā me kēia waihona waiwai ROM, hōʻoia ʻakomi i kāu hoʻoponopono ʻana i kāu lako, a mālama pono i kāu mea pāʻani.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Ke neʻe nei nā mea hana, piʻi ke kaiāulu.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Hoʻopakele i nā mea pāʻani i haʻihaʻi ʻia: ʻo nā māka palekana e hōʻoia i nā mea hou aʻe ʻaʻole nā ​​​​mea hana kahiko.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Nā ROM Stock i hoʻopaʻa ʻia: ʻO ka hōʻiliʻili piha o nā firmwares hale hana mua i hoʻopau ʻia ʻo Inniasis.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Nā mea hana uila piha no macOS, Linux, a me Windows like.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: ʻIke Lako Paʻa: ʻIke ʻakomi papa no laila e loaʻa mau iā ʻoe ka pūʻolo kūpono.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Ka pale ʻana i kāu hāmeʻa mai nā pahele haʻahaʻa haʻahaʻa a me nā hoʻoponopono hou ʻana.
strings.support_story_2_body: ʻO ka ʻimi ʻana i ka polokalamu Innioasis maʻamau, ʻo ia ka hoʻomaʻamaʻa ʻana i nā ʻaha kūkā no nā loulou Google Drive i pau, nā kaʻana ao Baidu make, a me nā faila zip pohihihi me nā mea hana ʻole. Ua kūkulu mākou i kahi pūnaewele hoʻoiho kūʻokoʻa hilinaʻi me ka kūpaʻa SHA-256 i hōʻoia ʻia, nā hoʻolaha hoʻolaha, a me nā hoʻonohonoho i alakaʻi ʻia. Mālama pololei kāu mau haʻawina i nā hoʻoiho a me ka hoʻokipa ʻana e hiki ai kēia 24 mau hola i ka lā, 365 mau lā o ka makahiki.
strings.support_story_2_headline: ʻAʻohe Google Drives haʻihaʻi. ʻAʻohe hana kuhi. Ke hana wale nei i ka firmware.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Hoʻoiho wikiwiki, hoʻoiho pololei ʻole me nā palena hoʻoiho a i ʻole nā ​​loulou make.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Hoʻolaha Hoʻolaha: E makaʻala i ka manawa i hoʻokuʻu ʻia ai ke kaiāulu hou a hāʻule paha nā hoʻoponopono.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Hoʻokomo ʻia i nā ʻanuʻu ʻanuʻu: Hoʻomaʻamaʻa ʻia nā ʻōkuhi hiʻohiʻona iā ʻoe ma kēlā me kēia pihi pihi.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kaiāulu 'Ōlelo Nui: Hoʻopili piha ʻia ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekania, Kina, Kelemānia, Paniolo, Palani a me Iapana.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Kiʻekiʻe kiʻekiʻe, hōʻoia ʻia nā ʻōnaehana kaiāulu hiki iā ʻoe ke hilinaʻi maoli.
strings.support_story_3_body: ʻO ka lako polokalamu hale kūʻai kūʻai wale nō e ʻoki i ka ʻili o ka mea hiki i kāu hāmeʻa Y1 a i ʻole Y2 ke hana. Hāʻawi ko mākou kaiāulu iā Rockbox, nā ʻōnaehana hana maʻamau māmā, pāʻani codec audiophile, a me nā kumuhana maʻamau i ke ola. Kūʻai mākou i nā ʻano ʻokoʻa kino kino ma waho o ka ʻeke e hoʻāʻo, hoʻohuli i ka ʻenekinia, a hōʻoia i kēlā me kēia hoʻokomo. ʻO ke kākoʻo ʻana i ka Updateater CE e hāʻawi kālā i kēia mau ʻāpana hoʻāʻo a hoʻolalelale i ka hoʻomohala ʻana i nā firmware maʻamau.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Wehe i ka mana piha o kāu mea pāʻani Innioasis.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Pāʻani Audiophile a me nā kumuhana maʻamau i hoʻokomo ʻia i kekona.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Hoʻonui i ka pākaukau, UI maʻemaʻe, a me ke kākoʻo codec leo hou.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Hoʻāʻo mākou i nā mea kino maoli ma mua o ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana i kekahi kūkulu.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% manuahi, polokalamu pilikino-mua me ka hoʻolaha ʻole a nānā ʻole.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Lawe mai i ka Rockbox, nā ʻōnaehana hana māmā maʻamau, a me ke kūʻokoʻa audiophile.
strings.support_story_4_body: Ke neʻe aku kahi ʻoihana lako i kā lākou hāmeʻa aʻe, haʻalele ʻia nā hiʻohiʻona kahiko. ʻAʻole hāʻawi ʻo Innioasis i ke kākoʻo Linux, ʻaʻohe changelogs maopopo, a ʻaʻohe ala maʻalahi e hoʻihoʻi i ka wā i pau ai kahi hoʻokomo. Aia ʻo Updater no ka mea ʻaʻole pono nā mea hoʻohana makemake e hoʻolei i kahi mea hoʻokani pila maikaʻi loa. 100% o nā hāʻawi kaiāulu e hele pololei i ka mālama ʻana i kēia hāmeʻa no kēlā me kēia.
strings.support_story_4_headline: E kōkua mai iā mākou e hana i ka mea ʻaʻole i hana ʻo Innioasis.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Hōʻike ʻia ka hoʻihoʻi hou ʻana inā hōʻole nā ​​​​mea hana i ka pahu.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Kākoʻo ʻo Linux First-Class: Kākoʻo piha ʻia ʻo MediaTek e uila ana ma Linux distros.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Nā memo hoʻokuʻu kikoʻī i ʻike pono ʻoe i nā loli.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Kākoʻo Kaiāulu: ʻO kēlā me kēia kofe e wehe i ka waihona a manuahi no nā mea a pau.
strings.support_story_4_lead: ʻO ka mālama ʻia ʻana o ka firmware i hoʻohana ʻia e ke kaiāulu e mālama ana i kāu mau mea hana mai nā pae ʻāina.

strings.themepack_step1_desc:
1. E ho'ā i kāu mea pāʻani ma ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ke pihi Power.
2. Ke ho'omaka 'o Rockbox, e ho'opili i ke kaula USB i kāu kamepiula.
3. Inā koi ʻia ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea pāʻani, e hōʻoia i ke ʻano USB Storage i ʻike ʻia ka hāmeʻa ma ke ʻano he drive.
